newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS says confirms ratings for Inco Ltd.
newsitem.headline: DBRS says confirms ratings for Inco Ltd.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it confirmed ratings on Inco Ltd's debentures and convertible preferred shares.
DBRS said that Inco's convertible preferred shares were confirmed at Pfd-3 with a stable trend. All series of Inco debentures were confirmed at BBB with stable trends.

"The current balance sheet strength, discretionary control over any share repurchases and ongoing productivity improvements which are increasing the company's cost competitiveness support Inco's current ratings," the rating agency said.
